title: Template:Flag
wikitext:
Template intended for use when referring to [[:Category:Players|players]], [[:Category:Clans|clans]] and/or [[:Category:Countries|countries]]. The 'name' field can be left blank if you just want the flag. == Usage == === Example === 
{{flag|flag=at|name=Gustav Klimt}}
The code above will appear as follows. {{flag|flag=at|name=Gustav Klimt}} ===Linking=== The template leaves it up to you if you wanna link the name/clan/country or not, eg: 
{{flag|flag=at|name=[[Egon Schiele]]}}
The code above will appear as follows. {{flag|flag=at|name=[[Egon Schiele]]}} [[Image:flag_{{{flag|}}}.gif|baseline]] {{ #if: {{{name|}}}|{{{name|}}}|}}
